newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Growth uncertain in Italy, France and Germany - Fazi.
newsitem.headline: Growth uncertain in Italy, France and Germany - Fazi.

text.p: Bank of Italy Governor Antonio Fazio said on Monday that despite very low inflation in France, Germany and Italy the outlook for economic growth was very uncertain.
"In France, Germany and Italy inflation is very low but growth is very uncertain," Fazio told reporters. He was attending a monthly meeting of Group of Ten (G10) central bank governors.
"What is putting a break on investments is the excessive tax burden and excessive regulation above all of labour," he added, apparently referring to all three countries.
"While there is a willingness to save there is an incapacity of the system, either public or private, to use it (savings)," he added.

Earlier Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer, who chaired the meeting at the Bank for International Settlements, told reporters that structural rigidities in European labour markets were the cause of high unemployment. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
